what: lan can đường đi bộ Hạ Long, a piece of 2 m of the parapet clad in grey granite on the sea side of the walk of Hạ Long
uses: Plan 0026, R4, R6: the parapet of the walk on the sea wall of Hạ Long, from Quang Trung to Cầu Đá (data/showcase/bai_truoc.json, sea_walls). A piece of a row along a line, as the sidewalk pieces of World: two pieces in a row join with no gap.

photos.author: Kwozyn
photos.shows: Two men sit on the parapet of the walk of the sea of Hạ Long at sunset, to the north-west: the parapet clad in smooth grey granite with a top slab and a panel of red brown granite, the walk of light tiles with dark square tiles, the boats of the bay, Núi Lớn.

photos.author: VnExpress
photos.shows: Hạ Long empty in the lockdown: the walk of the sea with a low parapet of light stone with dark red square pillars about every 10 m, lamp posts of four and five globes, benches, the road with a double yellow line.

photos.author: Venanzio_KH (Flickr)
photos.shows: The sea wall of Hạ Long from its foot: the sloped face of concrete panels down to rocks and the water, the walk on top with its low parapet, lamp posts of four globes, the road, a white hotel of about 7 storeys with the letters HA LONG HOTEL.

photos.author: trungydang
photos.shows: The sea wall of Hạ Long to the north: a smooth sloped face of concrete from the parapet down to rocks at the water, the parapet of rough stone, the walk with lamp posts of white globes, the road, hotels and Bãi Trước far away.

checks: Views: front (from the walk), back (from the sea), far.
The top is 0.9 m ± 0.1 m over the walk; smooth grey granite slabs and a lighter top slab.

envelope.depth.how: Photo 0: the top slab is about half the height of the parapet deep.

envelope.height.how: Photo 0: the man in white sits on the parapet; from his seat to the top of his head he is 160 px (about 0.9 m for a man who sits), and the front of the parapet is 175 px high from the walk: 0.9 m.

parts.wall.sizes.height.how: See envelope.height, less the top slab.

parts.wall.at.how: The base point of the model.

parts.wall.color.how: Photo 0 (2019): smooth grey granite slabs in the light of the evening; photo 1 (2021) shows a light stone. Photo 3 (2014) shows a parapet of rough stone, so the cladding is from between 2014 and 2019.

parts.top.sizes.height.how: Photo 0: the top slab is 20 px of the 175 px of the parapet: 0.1 m; 0.05 m over the cladding.
